basics.name: Mohamed Shamil Abdul Salam
basics.label: Software Engineer | Backend Developer | Fintech
basics.summary: Software Engineer focused on backend systems and financial workflows, with hands-on experience in Laravel, PHP, MySQL, REST APIs, asynchronous processing, webhooks, and third-party integrations. Experience working on payment, ACH, check, recurring transaction, payroll, banking, and accounting workflows in production, with emphasis on reliability, data integrity, security, and production debugging.

work.name: Zil Money
highlights: Built a service-provider “act-as-customer” API layer bringing 450 existing endpoints under delegated access, spanning 7 payment services and 38 webhook event types with audit trails and controls preventing providers from approving their own payments.

Hardened multi-level payment approvals by recording a destination fingerprint at payment creation, re-checking 3 bank fields at release, locking 3 payee/bank edit paths while payments are pending, and enforcing refusal handling across 4 approval entry points.

Automated recurring-payment safeguards across 5 payment types and 4 deletion paths, preventing execution against deleted destinations and correcting bulk-cancellation behavior across selected schedules.
Instrumented 16 AI features across 18 call sites for cost, token, and latency observability, enabling feature-level tracking of LLM usage and spend.

Shifted wallet-statement exports exceeding 1,000 transactions to background processing with PDF, CSV, and XLSX delivery, while maintaining Positive Pay fraud-prevention processing across 17 banking integrations.

work.name: Netplex Solutions
highlights: Analysed a legacy Laravel and PostgreSQL business-management and e-invoicing platform (routes, controllers, models, Blade views, roles and database structure) and contributed to its modular redesign on Inertia, Vue, TypeScript and Vite.
Gathered requirements from new clients across Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE and worked on their accounting workflows.

Independently developed and investigated the ZATCA e-invoicing workflow up to handover: XML generation, signing, hashing, TLV QR codes, certificate handling, validation and compliance-error investigation.

work.name: Inker Robotics
highlights: Supported web development, usability improvements, testing, documentation, and technology-focused educational initiatives.

work.name: Cert-Ed Academia
highlights: Managed financial and operational workflows while advising on technology and digital process improvements for an education-focused organization supporting 50+ learners.

projects.name: Cert-Ed Academia
highlights: Developed a 5-role education platform covering classes, assignments, grading, per-session attendance, hours-based billing, receipts, payslips, messaging, and scheduling.
Enforced access through 18 application-level capabilities and 50+ PostgreSQL row-level security policies, supported by 100+ unit tests and per-role database checks in CI.

projects.name: Masaar
highlights: Building an e-invoicing system with core functionality for electronic invoice generation, signing, QR processing, certificate management, and compliance-oriented workflows.

projects.name: Athar
highlights: Prototyping a security runtime with a Rust service and PHP/Laravel adapter that links payment events into lifecycles, records decision reasoning, and maintains a hash-chained, signed audit log.

projects.name: Time
highlights: Built a work-hours tracker used daily by 10+ colleagues and evolved it into a serverless multi-user service with scheduled data synchronization.

quickView.role: Software Engineer · Backend systems · Financial workflows
quickView.line: I build backend systems for financial workflows, where a mistake costs money or trust: who can act on an account, payments that must go where they were approved, and compliance. Laravel and TypeScript, with tests and logs to prove it works.

results.text: Providers work through the existing payment APIs with single-use keys, every call audited and every refusal identical.
Bank details are locked in at submission and re-checked before money moves.
XML generation, signing, hashing, QR codes and compliance-error investigation, developed up to handover.
